items.title: P&G Gillette finalized the 232 A Street purchase for its new Boston headquarters and innovation center
items.description: Breakthrough Properties reported that the 232 A Street development site sale to P&G Gillette is finalized for a planned roughly 325,000-square-foot Grooming Headquarters and Technical Innovation Center. This is a concrete project milestone, but no specific vendor procurement is stated.

items.title: T Market opened its Massachusetts flagship at Natick Mall
items.description: T Market opened its Massachusetts flagship at Natick Mall on August 27. The multi-department grocery, beauty, food-hall and bakery operation remains prospectable because the company publicly lists a purchasing contact; this does not imply a specific purchase is open.
why: Public purchasing contact is listed by the company

items.title: CPS Technologies leased an 80,000-square-foot Attleboro manufacturing facility
items.description: CPS Technologies signed a long-term lease for about 80,000 square feet in Attleboro and plans to relocate corporate offices, manufacturing and product development during 2027. A construction period runs through May 31, 2027; no specific vendor package is stated as open.

items.title: Nordstrom Rack is opening new stores in Plymouth and Mansfield
items.description: Nordstrom Rack lists a Colony Place Plymouth opening for September 3 and a Mansfield Crossing opening for October 29. The two-store rollout creates active pre-opening service windows without confirming any local vendor solicitation.

items.title: Synergy received a $4 million state award for the 294 Washington office-to-housing conversion
items.description: Massachusetts awarded $4 million in Commercial Conversion Tax Credits to Synergy for adaptive reuse of a historic Financial District office building into 255 rental homes and about 12,000 square feet of retail. The award is a concrete project milestone, not an open vendor solicitation.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities

items.title: Bicara Therapeutics signed for a 35,090-square-foot new Boston headquarters
items.description: Bicara Therapeutics disclosed a sub-sublease for about 35,090 square feet at 10 St. James Avenue for its new corporate headquarters, with a targeted commencement on or after October 1. This creates a defined pre-move window but is not an announced vendor procurement.

items.title: Tori Japan is preparing four new Greater Boston restaurants
items.location: Boston, Malden, Taunton and Dorchester, MA
items.description: Tori Japan confirmed plans for four Massachusetts-area restaurants. The first, near Boston University, is expected in late September, with Malden and Taunton targeted around year-end. No vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: Harvard Street Neighborhood Health Center is targeting a late-September groundbreaking for its new Dorchester facility
items.description: Harvard Street Neighborhood Health Center's CEO said the organization hopes to close remaining paperwork within about a month and could break ground by late September on a new facility, followed by an approximately 18-month construction process. The timing remains conditional and no vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Medical, dental, lab and pharmacy uses

items.title: Big Y is preparing to open a new Saugus supermarket
items.description: Big Y lists a September 10 opening for its new Saugus supermarket. The site is a strong pre-opening operating-services signal, not a confirmed vendor request.

items.title: Hawksmoor is opening a large Boston restaurant on September 8
items.description: Hawksmoor's first Boston restaurant is scheduled to open September 8 in Fort Point, with reporting describing a roughly 280-seat operation. The launch suggests recurring operating needs but does not confirm a vendor solicitation.

items.title: Forman Mills is opening its first Springfield store on September 17
items.description: Forman Mills says it will open its first Springfield location on September 17. The large-format retail launch creates plausible site-service needs but no local vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: SMC is expanding its Devens medical-device manufacturing campus
items.description: Massachusetts awarded SMC $1.25 million to renovate its existing 330,000-square-foot Devens facility and construct a new 100,000-square-foot building. The state-backed capital project includes HVAC, power and manufacturing-system work.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Slick City is preparing its first New England action park in Milford
items.description: Slick City's first New England indoor action park is expected to open in Milford in September, and the official location page remains marked coming soon with active recruiting. No vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Official page remains coming soon with active recruiting

items.title: Autonodyne is building an autonomy demonstration and training center in Boston
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Autonodyne $1 million for construction and equipment for a 6,500-square-foot autonomy demonstration center. The state says the company anticipates sourcing most project work from Massachusetts-based vendors.
why: Most project work anticipated from Massachusetts vendors
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Helfrich Bros. plans a new 65,000-square-foot Lawrence manufacturing facility
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Helfrich Bros. $1 million to help acquire adjacent land and construct a new 65,000-square-foot manufacturing facility with cranes, welding equipment, an automated paint booth and a testing station.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Pressed Cafe is preparing new Fenway and Dedham locations
items.location: 126 Brookline Avenue, Boston, MA; Dedham, MA
items.description: Pressed Cafe's official site lists Fenway and Dedham as coming soon. Fresh reporting places the Fenway location at 126 Brookline Avenue with a late-fall or winter 2026 opening window, while Dedham is also expected this fall. No vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Fenway opening window is late fall or winter 2026

items.title: Boston Dynamics is developing a 330,000-square-foot Waltham robotics center
items.description: Massachusetts says a Business Builds award will support renovation and buildout of approximately 330,000 square feet in Waltham for robotics manufacturing, training, R&D and related operations.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Fogo de Chão is preparing its first South Shore restaurant at South Shore Plaza
items.description: South Shore Plaza announced that Fogo de Chão will open its first South Shore restaurant there in spring 2027. The long lead time makes this an early fit-out and supplier prospecting signal rather than evidence of an active purchasing request.
why: Full-service restaurant with bar and dining spaces
items.sourceName: New England Real Estate Journal / South Shore Plaza
